policy: Per START_HERE_ZH.md, fixed scale C must come from a physical source (scanner DICOM/manual, simulation definition) or a recorded derivation. Per-image min-max is prohibited as the primary scale. Training-set global min-max is permitted only as an explicitly identified sensitivity arm.

brainweb.status: PENDING — BrainWeb PET simulation activity is a digital-phantom quantity with no direct physical Bq/mL constant. The BrainWeb simulator (http://brainweb.bic.mni.mcgill.ca/brainweb/) does not publish a fixed activity concentration. We must either (a) cite the simulation definition that ties each tissue class to a target concentration, (b) use a recorded data-derived candidate (e.g. training-set global maximum), or (c) contact the BrainWeb authors for a reference value.

physical_from_simulation_definition.evidence_path: PENDING — must link to BrainWeb simulator tissue-class → activity table.

training_set_global_max_zero_offset.derivation_rule: max over all train raw_activity arrays (after mean_pool_2x2_circular_fov). Compute via sam-kem calibrate-normalization on train only.
training_set_global_max_zero_offset.evidence_path: PENDING — will be emitted by calibrate-normalization under protocol code/configs/protocols/normalization_calibration.yaml.

training_set_global_minmax.clip_rule: validation values are clipped to [min_train, max_train] only as a sensitivity arm; zero point is min_train (not 0).
training_set_global_minmax.evidence_path: PENDING — sensitivity arm, never the primary scale.

hecktor.status: PENDING — HECKTOR.npz::input[...,1] is SUV (max ~4.5-15.2 per the START_HERE_ZH.md guide). The HECKTOR challenge does not publish a single fixed scanner-count constant. The previous v3 attempt used ~30000, but that constant applies to raw scanner counts, not SUV, and MUST NOT be used on the current SUV arrays.

physical_scanner_count_constant.evidence_path: PENDING — would require the original scanner list-mode / sinogram data, not present in HECKTOR.npz. This candidate is unavailable for the SUV arrays and should be excluded.

training_set_global_max_zero_offset.derivation_rule: max over all train raw_activity arrays (after physical_resample_circular_fov). Compute via sam-kem calibrate-normalization on train only.
training_set_global_max_zero_offset.evidence_path: PENDING — will be emitted by calibrate-normalization.

training_set_global_minmax.clip_rule: validation values are clipped to [min_train, max_train] only as a sensitivity arm.

next_step: Run sam-kem calibrate-normalization on the train split only. The output will populate training_set_global_max_zero_offset for both datasets. Until a physical source is recorded, the data-derived global-maximum candidate will be used as the PRIMARY scale. The training-set min-max and per-image min-max are sensitivity arms only.
forbidden_uses: Per-dataset arbitrary constant (e.g. 30000) without recorded source.
Test-set-derived constant (must never be opened before freeze).
